meta.name: browser-mate
meta.description: Use when automating a real, logged-in Chrome WITHOUT disturbing the user's open tabs — e.g. authenticated sessions like ChatGPT, LinkedIn, or any site needing a persistent login. Launches or reuses a dedicated debug Chrome instance per named profile that coexists with the user's main browser; it never quits or kills any browser (unlike real-browser, which closes Chrome Beta's tabs). Trigger on "automate this site without closing my tabs", "use my logged-in session", "open ChatGPT/LinkedIn in automation", or when a browser task must preserve the user's existing windows. macOS, requires the agent-browser CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控已登录的浏览器页面，不干扰正在浏览的标签
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不断开现有浏览器会话的情况下进行自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate logged-in browser pages without disturbing open tabs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser interactions while keeping your existing sessions intact

howto.what: 它不会关闭你当前的浏览器标签页，而是启动一个独立的Chrome实例，用于自动化操作，同时保留你的登录状态。这样你可以在不影响自己浏览的情况下，让助手自动处理网站任务。
howto.when: 当你需要自动化一个已登录的网站（如ChatGPT、LinkedIn），同时不希望关闭当前打开的标签页时触发。或者当你明确说“不要关闭我的标签页”时。

say.text: 帮我自动化ChatGPT，但别关掉我的标签页。
say.note: 助手会启动独立Chrome实例登录ChatGPT。

say.text: 用我已登录的LinkedIn发消息，别影响我当前浏览。
say.note: 助手复用之前登录的会话，不干扰主浏览器。

say.text: 打开自动化浏览器访问我的邮箱，保持我现有窗口不变。
say.note: 助手启动专用实例，不关闭你正在看的页面。

howto.what_en: It launches a separate Chrome instance (with its own user data directory and debug port) that coexists with your main browser, so your open tabs are never disturbed. The assistant can automate authenticated sites while you keep using your browser normally.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to automate a real, logged-in Chrome session (e.g., ChatGPT, LinkedIn) without closing your existing tabs, or when you say 'automate this site without closing my tabs' or 'use my logged-in session'.

say_en.text: Automate ChatGPT for me, but don't close my tabs.
say_en.note: Launches a dedicated Chrome instance to work with ChatGPT.

say_en.text: Use my logged-in LinkedIn session to send a message without disturbing me.
say_en.note: Reuses the existing profile login; your main browser stays untouched.

say_en.text: Open an automated browser to check my email while keeping my current windows.
say_en.note: Starts a separate instance, leaving your main browsing session intact.
